title: Spectacular
text: This was one of our favorite trips in Barcelona.  Just spectacular.  The tour guide was an hour late to pick us up from the hotel but he sincerely explained the reason.
author: Pioneer784126

title: Interesting!!
text: If there is a trip that should be take while in Barcelona, then this is it. Monteserrat is one of the places you should see at least once in your lifetime. The trip was interesting and the guide fun and attentive.
author: jessikaw349
